cases.purpose: A private passwd set-fd call uses a synthetic slot and writes a PHC verified independently.
cases.oracle: Original obligations, x86-64 UAPI request layouts, independent /usr/bin/argon2 CLI against a fixed reference vector, private account files and observable Linux PTY/status semantics. This deliberately synthetic stateful peer tests only client requests; it cannot establish the missing real kernel device or privileged credential transitions.
cases.comparison: Setup checks an independent Argon2id known vector, slot writes and one-shot export, cross-fd and duplicate-export errors, rejected token, scoped one-shot synthetic euid reply, real UID status, and denied credential syscall. Input shadow uses the project interface hex-field representation with digest independently computed by the independent /usr/bin/argon2 CLI and recorded. The stateful device is synthetic. In SU success only, one geteuid is answered 0 after consume to reach setgroups, which is denied EPERM; actual credentials do not change. PR_SET_DUMPABLE(0) is acknowledged without applying it. Exact raw I/O, errno, statuses, tty modes and private lock state are recorded. The set-fd result is additionally checked against independently calculated canonical PHC formatting. Listener bootstrap is precompiled and sends its listener before supervised operations; diagnostic stage files record the handoff. The source-review ownership and embedded-payload guard repairs are included. The CLI raw and encoded outputs and exact inputs are independently cross-checked and recorded.
